title: French Country Casserole
description: A creamy, comforting casserole with a delightful French twist, free from meat and suitable for a satisfying vegetarian meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the mushrooms in butter until tender.
Add the French onion soup mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
In a separate saucepan, combine the vegetable broth and crumbled brie cheese. Heat until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the baguette cubes in the bottom.
Spread the mushroom mixture over the bread, followed by the cheese mixture.
Top with the remaining bread cubes.
Dot the top with butter and sprinkle with thyme.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the top is golden brown.
